summary: Verified JSON IMPORT/EXPORT workaround in the WEB version of SIRIUS HUD setup. All 4 scenarios from the review request passed: (1) JSON file upload via setup-import-input populates name, profession, and all 4 password key fields exactly; (2) submitting completes setup, persists sirius_profile and sirius_keys to localStorage, HUD shows DANIEL and 'IA CLOUD · GROQ' connection status; (3) Export button triggers a download with filename 'sirius-profil.json'; (4) No onPaste blocker on web inputs - programmatic fill works fine. The Electron-only paste fix (public/electron.js menu/context-menu) was not tested as it is not reachable from the web preview, as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: SiriusSetup.jsx importProfile() silently swallows JSON.parse errors (empty catch block). Consider surfacing a user-facing error so the user knows when their .json file is invalid, especially since this is the recommended workaround for the Electron paste bug.
importProfile() does not validate the shape of data.keys (e.g. could contain unexpected fields). Low risk since values are stored locally but worth whitelisting keys to {groq,serp,gemini,openai}.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/sirius-profil.json with the test JSON payload from the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview verifies JSON import/export workaround only. Packaged Electron paste menu (public/electron.js Edit menu + context-menu) cannot be tested in the Linux web preview - must be verified by running the packaged desktop build locally. Test JSON file at /tmp/sirius-profil.json. Setup overlay is gated by localStorage 'sirius_profile' + 'sirius_keys'; clear both and reload to re-open.
